title: 描述身体部位的特征表达

questions.knowledge_point: 描述身体部位的特征表达
questions.question: 句子 'It has big eyes.' 的意思是 '它有小眼睛'。
questions.explanation: big意思是'大的'，所以是'大眼睛'。

questions.knowledge_point: 描述身体部位的特征表达
questions.question: The rabbit has ________ ears.
questions.explanation: 兔子的耳朵特征是'长的'(long)。

questions.knowledge_point: 描述身体部位的特征表达
questions.question: It ________ a long nose.
questions.explanation: 描述某物拥有什么特征部位，主语是It，谓语动词用has。

questions.knowledge_point: 描述身体部位的特征表达
questions.question: Come here, children! Look ________ the elephant.

questions.knowledge_point: 描述身体部位的特征表达
questions.question: It has ________ small head.
questions.explanation: head是可数名词单数，开头辅音音素用a。

questions.knowledge_point: 描述身体部位的特征表达
questions.question: It has a short tail. It has big eyes. It is ________.
questions.explanation: 兔子符合短尾巴和大眼睛的特征。

questions.knowledge_point: 描述身体部位的特征表达
questions.question: It ___ a big body.

questions.knowledge_point: 描述身体部位的特征表达
questions.question: 将下列身体部位与中文意思连线。
questions.explanation: tail-尾巴, nose-鼻子, eye-眼睛, body-身体。

questions.knowledge_point: 描述身体部位的特征表达
questions.question: 连词成句：(has, it, nose, a, long)
questions.explanation: 描述物体的固定句型：It has + a + 形容词 + 部位。
